name: Seasons in Short Lines
description: Twelve short lines about spring, summer, autumn and winter, three of each.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Twelve short seasonal lines to type, shown on Typing Drills in flow mode.
help.goal: Nothing to beat. Type at a pace that suits you and stop whenever you like.
howToPlay: Keep going without worrying about mistakes.
At the end of a line the next one appears.
tips: Lines are short so they are easy to pick up and put down. Your place is saved on this device.
